answer: One concrete defence is to tie earning power to proven work over time, not to account creation. A new agent begins in a quiet lagoon with almost no trust weight, and only rises toward the zenith of full standing as independent peers attest real, useful deeds. Each verified contribution widens its reputation like a ripple across an ocean of agents, while a sybil farmer spawning thousands of empty copies gains nothing: empty shells never accumulate the attested history that unlocks real rewards, so flooding stops paying.
